headings.text: Three views of the same tournament
A draw that can be checked again
Seven rounds without seven separate systems

images.alt: Ecube Tournament — public homepage for Return of King: Free Fire

diagrams.text:
Web · reseller
The Next.js client uses Redux Toolkit and Ant Design for the reseller dashboard.
Web · supplier
The same Next.js app provides the supplier dashboard, scoped to its role.
Native · reseller
The Expo and Tamagui reseller app is available on Google Play.
Shared API
All three surfaces consume the Laravel REST API. Pusher channels carry updates to the clients that need them.

headings.text: Plugging into a Laravel API I didn't write

images.alt: SelfShop — reseller product and dashboard view
Reseller dashboard — orders, products, payouts
Supplier dashboard — vendor catalog, stock, dispatch
SelfShop Reseller on Google Play — listing, ratings, and app previews
Reseller app — category catalog with promotional framing
Reseller app — dashboard with sales, profit, and wallet balance

diagrams.text:
Web · tiered storefront
Next.js 16 provides the web storefront for the platform’s participant tiers.
Native · buyer app
The Expo buyer app is part of the platform under development.
Shared API
Both clients use the documented Hono and oRPC API through a shared typed client.
Shared data
Postgres stores catalog and content data, with Drizzle, Better-Auth, and Lexical.

images.alt: Bikalpo — B2B storefront on b2b.bikalpo.com

diagrams.text:
Web · public and admin
A marketing site and an admin console have separate web surfaces.
Web · teacher and guardian
Teachers and guardians each use a role-specific web portal.
Native · teacher and guardian
Two Expo apps connect to the same API as the web portals.
Shared API and schema
Hono and oRPC connect every surface to Postgres. Shared packages hold the Drizzle schema, authentication, and contracts.

images.alt: Bright Tutor — marketing site on brighteducations.com

diagrams.text:
Movement log
Receiving, sales, transfers, and returns each record a stock movement.
Sum the movements
In this example: 100 received, 3 sold, 10 transferred, 1 sold, and 1 returned.
Derived count · 87 units
SKU-1042 has 87 units on hand. The count is calculated from the log rather than stored as a separate stock total.

headings.text: Optimistic UI with a real audit trail

images.alt: Stock Management — distributor operations dashboard

diagrams.text:
Web · public and admin
Next.js 16 serves the public catalog and admin CMS in separate route groups.
API · Hono on Bun
The storefront and CMS use one typed oRPC contract for services, content, and listing approvals.
Shared data
Postgres stores the catalog and workflow. Drizzle defines the schema; Better-Auth handles sessions.

headings.text: User-submitted services without polluting the catalog
Homepage as data, not hard-coded JSX
